name: KinFlo hosted activation evidence ledger

providerBoundary.notes: This ledger records the evidence expected after approval. It does not provision Convex, run codegen, import generated API, execute hosted Convex functions, touch provider APIs, or read/print secrets.

evidenceSteps.label: Repo sharing risk posture
evidenceSteps.commandOrAction: Approve history purge or private-repo residual-risk posture before public/client sharing.
evidenceSteps.evidenceTarget: Secret-history audit result plus explicit sharing decision.
evidenceSteps.rollback: Keep repository private and pause external/client review until history posture is approved.

evidenceSteps.label: Hosted Convex ownership
evidenceSteps.commandOrAction: Create or select hosted Convex project with ownership, billing, backup, auth, and env policy approved.
evidenceSteps.evidenceTarget: Convex dashboard project URL and owner/billing/backup notes captured outside committed source.
evidenceSteps.rollback: Keep all shell surfaces on fixtures and do not run hosted Convex commands.

evidenceSteps.label: Env and codegen approval
evidenceSteps.commandOrAction: Configure Convex/auth env values outside committed source, then approve npm run convex:codegen.
evidenceSteps.evidenceTarget: Generated bindings reviewed against KINFLO_GENERATED_API_BINDINGS without committing secrets.
evidenceSteps.rollback: Delete generated files from the working tree and keep generatedApiAvailable false.

evidenceSteps.label: Read-only hosted smokes
evidenceSteps.commandOrAction: Run activation.readiness, viewer, role/access, tenant/site, public renderer, and launch readiness reads first.
evidenceSteps.evidenceTarget: Read-only smoke outputs prove tenant/site scope and launchReadiness.getSiteLaunchReadiness parity.
evidenceSteps.rollback: Stop activation and keep fixtureKinfloShellAdapter selected if any read leaks scope or mismatches fixture expectations.

evidenceSteps.label: Mutation smoke order
evidenceSteps.commandOrAction: Run mutation smokes in docs/convex-live-smoke-manifest.json order after read-only smokes pass.
evidenceSteps.evidenceTarget: Audit events, rollback notes, and smoke record ids captured for tenant, site, invite, publish, and lead flows.
evidenceSteps.rollback: Archive smoke data and pause all mutation/provider steps on any permission, audit, or cleanup failure.

evidenceSteps.label: Fixture-to-live adapter switch
evidenceSteps.commandOrAction: Switch adapters one surface at a time only after its smoke evidence passes.
evidenceSteps.evidenceTarget: Surface-level switch evidence from Adapter Switch Readiness with rollback confirmed.
evidenceSteps.rollback: Return the affected surface to fixture data and keep every other surface blocked until reviewed.

evidenceSteps.label: Provider write approvals
evidenceSteps.requiredBefore: DNS, billing, communications, storage, or AI writes
evidenceSteps.commandOrAction: Approve each non-Convex provider separately: DNS, SSL, Vercel domain, Stripe, SendGrid, Twilio, storage, and AI.
evidenceSteps.evidenceTarget: Separate provider smoke packet with consent, unsubscribe, usage cap, source-safety, and rollback proof.
evidenceSteps.rollback: Keep provider metadata local and leave sends/uploads/domain attachment/AI generation disabled.

completionRules: No hosted Convex deployment is created by this phase.
No live Convex query, mutation, or action is executed.
Every step remains review-only until Vambah approves the matching hosted gate.
evidenceTargets: launchReadiness.getSiteLaunchReadiness hosted output for Julie and one new client site
publicSite.resolvePublishedSite hosted output for a published smoke page
crm.submitLead smoke lead id plus crm.listLeads scoped proof
controlPlane.listAuditEvents audit entries for identity, activation, site creation, invitation, publish, and lead capture
cross-tenant deny proof for client admin role
